# Heading

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

A text block that registers itself as a heading in the Table of Contents when rendered. On first render, the element records its page number against `TocIdentifier` in the `TocEntries` dictionary so that a `VisualToc` can display the correct page reference.

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Extends `TextBlock`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new Heading(string text)
```

## Properties

- [`AnchorId`](#anchorid): Optional named-anchor id.
- [`Level`](#level): Heading level (1–6).
- [`SemanticRole`](#semanticrole): The heading role for the heading's `Level`: `H1` to `H6`.
- [`TocIdentifier`](#tocidentifier): Gets or sets the unique identifier used to look up this heading in the TOC entries dictionary.

### `AnchorId`

```csharp
string AnchorId { get; set; }
```

Optional named-anchor id. When set, this heading doubles as a cross-reference target: it records its page number against `AnchorId` in the shared TOC registry so a `SectionLink` can jump to it and a `PageNumberOf` can print its page. Independent of `TocIdentifier` (which drives the on-page `VisualToc`); a heading may carry either, both, or neither.

### `Level`

```csharp
int Level { get; set; }
```

Heading level (1–6). Maps to PDF/UA structure roles `H1`…`H6` when the document opts into tagging via `DocumentSettings.Accessibility`. Default `1`. Values outside 1–6 are clamped.

### `SemanticRole`

```csharp
SemanticRole SemanticRole { get; }
```

*read-only*

The heading role for the heading's `Level`: `H1` to `H6`. Levels above 6 use `H6`, and levels below 1 use `H1`.

### `TocIdentifier`

```csharp
string TocIdentifier { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets the unique identifier used to look up this heading in the TOC entries dictionary. Must match the identifier passed to `HeadingIdentifiers`.

## Methods

- [`RenderStateful`](#renderstateful): Renders this heading in a stateful manner, registering the TOC entry on first render and delegating text rendering to the base `TextBlock` implementation.
- [`ResetState`](#resetstate): Resets the render state so the heading can be re-rendered on subsequent layout passes (e.g. during two-pass TOC resolution).
